_meta.note: Figures pulled from the official FHFC / eHousingPlus lender guide dated 07-20-2026 and the live rate card dated 07-22-2026. Rates change daily — lender confirms in the eHPortal at lock.

funding_status.note: Cannot switch an existing reservation to HTH.

repayment_triggers: borrower ceases to occupy as primary residence
restrictions: Not a stand-alone DPA — must close with an HTH first mortgage
Cannot be combined with any other Florida Housing DPA program
Other agencies' DPA permitted only if stand-alone and in third lien position
Cannot bridge an appraisal gap or repay borrower debt

_provenance.note: UNVERIFIED. The guide says '5% of the TOTAL loan amount' and the eHPortal auto-calculates it. Whether 'total' includes financed UFMIP / VA funding fee / USDA guarantee fee is not stated. Confirm with a participating lender. Until then compute off the base loan and label the output as an estimate the lender confirms at reservation.

tba.label: TBA (The Bond Alternative)
tba.income_counted: credit qualifying / AUS income of borrowers on the loan, including any non-occupying co-signor
tba.note: Household income is not used. FTHB status of a spouse not on the loan is not considered.

bond.label: Bond
bond.fthb_status_checked: all borrowers, non-purchasing spouse, and anyone on the deed

funding_options.switching: A change from HTH Bond to HTH TBA is not allowed unless the property address changes.

dti.rounding: Servicer rounds up at .50 and down at .49

conventional_hfa_advantage.note: Freddie Mac HFA Advantage only. Reduced-cost MI when credit qualifying income is at or below 80% AMI (Freddie Mac sets the AMI, not FL Housing). LPA required — DU not accepted.

_provenance.note: UNVERIFIED. MI and funding-fee percentages are agency figures, not published in the FHFC guide. Verify against current FHA/VA/USDA/Freddie Mac schedules before showing a monthly payment.

fees.origination_note: HTH waives the standard 1% origination fee. Lenders may not charge it.
fees.doc_stamp_note: First and second notes and mortgages are exempt under s.420.513(1) F.S. Deeds are NOT exempt.

fthb_exemptions: purchasing in a federally designated targeted area
veterans discharged under other than dishonorable conditions (DD214 required, COE not accepted)
active-duty military and Reserves/National Guard under TBA with a current LES

employment.veterans_note: Veterans must be employed full-time. They are exempt from the eligible-employer requirement, NOT from the full-time requirement.

homebuyer_education.exempt: Veterans, active military, Reserves and National Guard — unless using HFA Advantage. Co-signors never need to attend.

eligibility.one_time_participation: All borrowers, including non-occupying co-signors, are limited to one-time participation across all Florida Housing homebuyer programs — first and second mortgages.
eligibility.co_signors: Permitted with FHA and Freddie Mac only. Cannot appear on the deed or execute the mortgage. Their income IS counted under TBA.

property_types.condos: Follow agency guidelines. Single-unit approval permitted for FHA.
property_types.units_2_to_4: Borrower must occupy one unit as primary residence.
property_types.manufactured_housing: 1994 or newer. FHA, USDA-RD and VA only. Max 45% DTI.

timeline.new_construction: Certificate of Occupancy must be issued before reservation. Cancels at day 91, no exceptions.
timeline.note: Lender must hold a fully executed purchase contract before locking.

_limits_provenance.why_empty: The 67-county tables live on pages 18-19 of the FHFC TBA lender guide as embedded images and did not extract as text. They must be transcribed from the PDF or requested from a participating lender.
_limits_provenance.tba_note: One flat limit per county. No household-size adjustment. Higher than Bond.
_limits_provenance.bond_note: Adjusted by household size (1-2 person vs 3+ person). Lower than TBA.
_limits_provenance.targeted_area_note: Bond income limits are higher in federally designated targeted areas (Qualified Census Tracts), and the first-time homebuyer requirement is waived there.
_limits_provenance.usda_note: USDA-RD first mortgages follow USDA's own income limits, which are generally lower.
_limits_provenance.rule: Until populated, eligibility gates must render 'pending verification'. Never guess a number.
